chunks: What Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār narrated from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān or someone else, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
For every ghusl there is wudu, except janabah; and the manner of reconciling between them is what we have mentioned previously.

key_terms.الْجَمْعِ: reconciling or combining apparently differing reports
key_terms.الْجَنَابَةَ: the state of major ritual impurity caused by janabah
key_terms.غُسْلٍ: ritual bath performed for a state requiring purification
key_terms.قَدَّمْنَاهُ: what was previously presented or explained

ai.seo_question: Is wudu required with every ghusl, or is ghusl al-janabah an exception?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning ritual purity: wudu is required with every ghusl except the ghusl of janabah. It also indicates that the reconciliation of apparently differing reports on this issue has already been explained earlier.
